headings.usage: Use for Model names, headers in the sidebar, and main section titles.

body.usage: Use for standard AI responses (Risultato) and general UI text.

monospace.usage: Use exclusively for the 'Insight' panel, latency_index, capability_score, and routing logs.

typography.instructions: Avoid Inter/Roboto for headings. Keep hierarchy strict. Jump no more than 2 steps (e.g., text-3xl to text-lg).

colors.background: bg-slate-950 (Midnight Blue base tinted with slate)
colors.accents: Electric Blue (sky-400 to blue-500). Use selectively for the active AI model indicator and primary send action.
colors.borders: border-slate-800/50 for subtle separation, border-sky-500/30 for active/focus states.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Apply Optical Clarity: backdrop-blur-xl combined with backdrop-saturate-150 and a 1px border-white/5 top inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.borders: Never use solid high-contrast borders unless for the tracing beam effect on active models. Rely on elevation and soft borders.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]) for floating elements like the prompt input area.
visual_enhancers.animations: No visible loading spinners (BANNED). Use elegant skeleton sweeps or 'typing' text fade-ins. Use transition-colors duration-300 ease-out for hover states.

component_name.chat_input: Multimodal Input Area. Floating glassmorphic dock at the bottom of the screen. Must include paperclip icon for PDF/Image upload. Must look heavy and anchored.
component_name.model_router: Intent Detection UI. A sleek, horizontal status pill showing 'Routing to GPT-4o...'. Display capability_score, latency_index, and cost_efficiency as micro-badges next to it.
component_name.response_panel: Dual-Output Panel. Top half: 'Risultato' (clear, readable text). Bottom/Side half: 'Insight' (technical explanation of routing choice, monospaced, tinted dark blue background).
component_name.quick_actions: Quick-Action Bar containing: Copia, Salva in Archivio, Rielabora, Condividi. These should be subtle ghost buttons (hover:bg-slate-800) aligned to the bottom right of every output.
component_name.archive_registry: Model Registry & Archive View. Dense, technical grid layout. Use subtle borders (border-b border-slate-800). No heavy cards; go cardless/rectangular.

grids.desktop: grid-cols-12 gap-6. Sidebar spans 3 cols, Main Chat spans 9 cols. Inside Main Chat, Responses max-w-4xl.
grids.bento_rules: For the Model Registry, use dense data correlation layout. Every pixel utilized. h-full for children.

layouts.dashboard: Single-page AI orchestrator. Sidebar on the left (fixed), main scrolling chat area on the right. Input fixed to bottom of chat area.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing: p-6 or p-8 inside primary response panels to give text breathing room.

motion.hover: Hover states must have higher contrast than default. Elements lift (-translate-y-1) with a soft shadow.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform duration-200, transition-colors duration-200. Do not use transition-all indiscriminately.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism meets 4.5:1 ratio. Text colors must be explicitly set on hover (e.g., hover:text-white).
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='send-prompt-btn', data-testid='action-copy').

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a technical, crisp look.

abstract_ai_background.description: Abstract blue glowing dots forming wave patterns
abstract_ai_background.instructions: Use as a very low opacity (opacity-5 or opacity-10) fixed background image or in the empty state of the chat to signify 'The Intelligent Orchestrator'.

user_avatar.description: A smiling man with arms crossed against black background
user_avatar.instructions: Use for the logged-in enterprise user avatar in the bottom of the sidebar.

3d_libraries.strategy: Avoid heavy 3D rendering for the core chat interface to maintain performance (latency_index is critical). Use CSS gradients and glassmorphism exclusively for depth.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be Italian for all UI text (Risultato, Insight, Copia, Salva in Archivio, Rielabora, Condividi).
Implement 'Clarity-First' design: No cluttered borders, use optical alignment.
Build a pure dark mode UI using Midnight Blue and Slate Grey backgrounds, with Electric Blue accents for active states.
For the Quick-Action bar, ensure it appears attached to every response payload as small icon+text glass pills.
Model Registry should be built as a dense, cardless table view or list view using standard HTML elements styled via Tailwind.
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for any overlays or dropdowns; always use glassmorphism (bg-slate-900/60 + backdrop-blur) or a solid dark color.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not center-align the main app container. Use layered depth (z-index) and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl with backdrop-saturate-150). Do not use 'transition: all'. Apply distinct typography for 'Risultato' (Standard reading layout using Manrope) and 'Insight' (Technical/Monospace log layout using JetBrains Mono) to communicate professional control and computational power. Always include data-testid on interactable elements. Never use AI emoji characters for icons; rely strictly on lucide-react.
